name: Utsugi Ichiya
source:
"I got something to protect."

A graduate of the school who is currently a music producer. For some reason, he's currently raising Mirai for his distant relatives. He's often too busy to take care of him, so he sometimes leaves him at the school for a short while.

He can't stand rumors that he's an actor or an idol. But right now, Mirai is the most important thing to him.

He teases Ruka that he looks like Mirai and is viewed coldly by his brother, Sen'ya.

Hobby: Billiards
Favorite Food: Mirai yuki
Dislikes: Traffic

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041205190632/http://www.will-game.com/BCM/gb01/char07.htm]official website[/url]]
